caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden shelving unit with three open shelves and a single drawer at the bottom. The unit is shown upright with four decorative finials, one on each corner on the top, each with a spindle shape and pointed tip. The sides and edges of the shelving unit have rounded, column-like vertical supports with golden-brown coloring, while the main panels and shelves are shaded in a reddish-brown hue, indicating a polished wood surface. The bottom drawer features a large, central brass handle, and the unit stands on four rounded, turned legs with small casters underneath each leg. The background is a plain, off-white or parchment color, and the primary drawing is framed with a faint rectangular outline. In the upper right corner, there is a small, lightly sketched plan view of the furniture. Handwritten text in red ink identifying the artist and a number is present at the bottom left within the frame.
title: Bookcase
